predictions.selection_reason: RLE compressed data -> bounds validation -> prevents buffer overrun during decompression
predictions.source_summary: c->rleoffset and c->rlelength come from SGI image file RLE tables (starttab and lengthtab arrays) populated from file data. c->bufsize is the file size minus SGI header size.
predictions.sink_summary: The unchecked values would be used in expandrow/expandrow2 functions as source pointers and lengths for RLE decompression operations.
predictions.guard_summary: The added check prevents buffer overrun by validating that rleoffset + rlelength does not exceed the allocated buffer size. If violated, sets error code and returns early.
predictions.risk_pattern: Bounds check added to prevent reading beyond allocated buffer during RLE decompression of SGI image data.
enclosing_conditions: Loop over image rows (c->rowno) and channels (c->channo)
predictions.context_summary: The check is added in the main decompression loop to validate RLE table entries before they are used to access the compressed data buffer.
unresolved_facts: Whether the RLE table values (starttab/lengthtab) are validated for consistency before this check
Whether there are other potential overflow paths in the decompression functions

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: integer overflow in offset + length calculation leading to buffer overrun
retrieval_query.impact: bypass of bounds check via integer overflow
